description: Source of truth for the org's inter-service dependencies (code-verified). The planner reads this in Phase 1 to compute blast radius. ONLY live flows are listed — stale/dead flows are deliberately omitted to avoid context-window bloat. Update when wiring changes.
callChain: ClientApp -> ServerApp (REST + Socket.io) -> AIClusterApp (HTTP, BACKEND_*_ENDPOINT, v2) -> {ClinicalAIServices /score | Billing-Engine /icd,/cpt,/nbq | AIMedVision /message | PromptFlowApp intake-summary + after-visit-summary ONLY}. Separately: ClientApp -> LiveKit cloud (WebRTC, token from ServerApp) -> LivekitAgents (dispatch by agentName).
ignoreForContext: Do NOT load stale PromptFlowApp flows (assessment, treatment-recommendation, treatment-summary, AVS) into agent context. They are dead code replaced by ClinicalAIServices. Only the 2 live PromptFlowApp flows below are relevant.

services.name: ClientApp
services.stack: React 18 + Ionic 8 + Vite + Capacitor 6 + TanStack Query + axios + socket.io-client + livekit-client
services.notes: Does NOT call AIClusterApp or any LLM microservice directly. Never bypasses ServerApp.

services.name: ServerApp
services.stack: NestJS 11 + Drizzle ORM + Postgres + Socket.io + livekit-server-sdk + @azure/cosmos + @azure/service-bus + axios
services.role: Monolithic backend. Socket.io server. Mints LiveKit tokens. DB schema source of truth.
services.notes: Reaches LLM microservices ONLY via AIClusterApp, never directly. No /score or ClinicalAIServices reference in ServerApp/src.

services.name: AIClusterApp
services.stack: Python 3.11 + FastAPI + uvicorn + requests + azure-cosmos + psycopg3 + Azure Key Vault
services.role: API GATEWAY for LLM microservices. Routes ServerApp requests to the right AI service.
services.notes: THE gateway. /scribe and /get_persona_doc DEPRECATED (410 Gone). Routes: /intake_summary,/treatment_recommendation,/assessment,/treatment_summary,/after_visit_summary,/icd/*,/cpt/*,/nbq/seed,/message,/document_quality.

services.name: ClinicalAIServices
services.stack: Python 3.11 + FastAPI + pydantic-ai + psycopg3 + httpx + Azure OpenAI/Search
services.role: LLM microservices: assessment-recommendation, treatment-recommendation. Replaces PromptFlowApp v1 flows.
services.notes: Exposes POST /score. Only assessment & treatment-recommendation services exist. AVS, intake-summary, treatment-summary still on PromptFlowApp.

services.name: Billing-Engine
services.stack: Python + FastAPI + pydantic-ai + psycopg3 + httpx + Azure Search
services.notes: No outbound HTTP to any fleet service. Leaf. Exposes /icd/*,/cpt/*,/nbq/seed,/health.

services.name: PromptFlowApp
services.stack: Python + PromptFlow tool + psycopg3 + Azure Key Vault (legacy)
services.role: Legacy. ONLY 2 LIVE FLOWS remain: intake-summary, after-visit-summary. All other flows (assessment, treatment-recommendation, treatment-summary, AVS) are STALE dead code replaced by ClinicalAIServices — DO NOT load into agent context.

calls.mechanism: REST (requests, trigger_icd_coding -> /icd/suggest, background) — only for live flows

services.notes: When planning, account for PromptFlowApp ONLY if the feature touches intake-summary or after-visit-summary. For any other AI flow, route to ClinicalAIServices, NOT PromptFlowApp.

services.name: LivekitAgents
services.stack: Python 3.13 + livekit-agents (uv workspace) + psycopg3 + openai/azure plugins
services.role: Voice agents (intake, scribe). Dispatched by LiveKit cloud via agentName set by ServerApp.
services.notes: Not in HTTP request chain. Two agents: intake, scribe.

services.name: AIMedVision
services.stack: Python + Azure Functions (durable) + FastAPI/uvicorn + psycopg3 + internal vision-model (VLM)
services.role: Medical report/lab image parsing. Called by AIClusterApp /message.
services.notes: Fans out to its own vision-model VLM subproject.

services.name: LLMQuality
services.stack: Python + Django + azure-ai-evaluation + azure-cosmos + livekit-api + psycopg2
services.role: Test/eval harness. NOT part of production request chain.
services.notes: Eval harness only. Not in prod call chain.

Postgres-app.criticalNote: DB schema change = WIDEST blast radius (7 services). Any schema delta MUST be flagged as touching all 7.

KeyVault.note: Exact legacy secret names are sacred. Never invent new env vars.

blastRadiusRules: ClientApp UI feature -> check if needs new ServerApp API endpoint (REST or Socket.io event) -> which may need new AIClusterApp route -> which may need new ClinicalAIServices/PromptFlowApp(live flows only) flow or Billing-Engine endpoint.
ClinicalAIServices flow change -> check AIClusterApp routing (as-pf-*-postgres-url secrets) -> check ServerApp BACKEND_*_ENDPOINT -> check ClientApp UI if user-facing.
Billing-Engine endpoint change -> check all callers: AIClusterApp, ClinicalAIServices, PromptFlowApp(live flows).
LivekitAgents change -> check ServerApp dispatch (agentName) + LiveKit token flow + ClientApp realtime UI.
DB schema change -> FLAG ALL 7 Postgres-app services. ServerApp drizzle migration is source of truth. This is the highest-blast-radius change type.
Key Vault secret change -> check all Python services that resolve that secret. Never rename secrets.
AIMedVision change -> check AIClusterApp /message (fileMessage) caller. Usually contained.
unconfirmedFromCode: Actual URL values of ServerApp BACKEND_*_ENDPOINT (live in Key Vault/ADO Library, not repo). ServerApp->AIClusterApp inferred from route-shape parity + ClinicalAIServices docstrings.

Whether BACKEND_SCRIBE_ENDPOINT, BACKEND_PERSONA_DOC_ENDPOINT, LLM_BRAIN_ENDPOINT point at AIClusterApp (deprecated /scribe,/get_persona_doc return 410) or ClinicalAIServices/LivekitAgents. Ask Sahil.

Which as-pf-*-postgres-url secrets now point at ClinicalAIServices vs still-live PromptFlowApp. Ask Sahil which flows are cut over (confirmed: assessment & treatment-recommendation are ClinicalAIServices; intake-summary & after-visit-summary still PromptFlowApp).
